note: Marks of the alternative payment methods, for the payment page (checkout) and the POS app (terminal). Each mark sits on a fixed tile; the tile colour is chosen per method so the artwork reads well in light and dark themes alike, and every mark gets the same tile size.

alipay.name: Alipay
alipay.note: Colour lockup (blue symbol, black wordmark): white tile.

wechat.name: WeChat Pay
wechat.note: File received is the WeChat lockup, not the WeChat Pay mark: replace it when the Pay mark arrives.

twint.name: TWINT
twint.note: White-on-black version: black tile (#000). Needs a colour version for light tiles if the scheme asks for one.

paypal.name: PayPal
paypal.note: Colour horizontal lockup (pp_h_rgb): white tile. The black version and the vertical lockups were received and not used.

klarna.name: Klarna
klarna.note: Black wordmark on the tile in Klarna Pink #FFA8CD (the same artwork as the Klarna payment badge, which was received and is not used as a file). Tile values: light #FFFFFF, dark #000000, pink #FFA8CD.

bizum.name: Bizum
bizum.note: Teal lockup (Horizontal_azul) on a white tile. The white version was received and is not used: it would go on a teal tile if ever needed.

blik.name: BLIK
blik.note: Official badge (black gradient with its soft shadow, red dot) on a white tile.

mbway.name: MB WAY
mbway.note: Positive horizontal lockup (black MB, red brackets) on a white tile. Vector. Negative (white MB), black, white and vertical versions were received and are not used.

ideal.name: iDEAL | Wero
ideal.note: Official co-logo, yellow horizontal lockup (vector, its own #FFF48D background): the tile takes the same yellow so they merge. The square lockup was received and is not used. Mandatory name since 31 March 2026.
